en: Sepia-toned historic street scene of a German town square. A row of multi-story gabled houses with tiled roofs lines a wide cobbled square. Shop signs on the facades include "Restaurant zur Post" and "Conditorei u. Cafe". People and children stand and walk in the street, with an early automobile and a bicycle visible. At the top center of the card is printed the town name "Stolpen i. Sa."
